Umāsvāti(mi)_Vācaka
Jain; styled Gṛddhrapiccha; said to have been born of Vātsī an. Svāti; lived in 1st cent. A. D.; born a. Nyagrodhikā but wrote his work in Pāṭalīputra; credited with authorship of 500 prakaraṇas, in Jinaprabhasūri's Tīrthakalpa; see App. D. Bib. Ind. edn. of his Tattvārthasūtras for q.s. from his other works; taken sometimes a. a Śvetāmbara, but a teacher common to both schools. The Kāṣṭhāsaṅgha is said to have arisen in his time. See Peters. II. Intro. p.. 78-79. IV. Index of Authors, p.. xvi-xvii; Ind. Ant. XX. p.. 341, 351.
